The Planner should have stopped after the second WebSurfer turn where the search result explicitly showed "Edmond T. Gréville died in Nice, Alpes-Maritimes, France" and "He died on 26 May 1966 in Nice, Alpes-Maritimes, France" from IMDb. The Planner's failure to recognize this clear evidence and synthesize the answer is the root cause of the extended and ultimately unsuccessful search.
